questions.stem: Identify the True statement among the following?

options.label: A
options.text: Stratum Spinosum is underdeveloped in Very Low Birth Weight infants in the initial 7 Days.

options.label: B
options.text: Icthyosis Vulgaris is due to the Deficiency of Filaggrin Protein which is found in Stratum Basale

options.label: C
options.text: The Malpighian Layer of the Epidermis includes both Stratum Basale & Stratum Granulosum as a unit.

options.label: D
options.text: Skin, Hairs, Nails, the Subcutaneous Tissue below the Skin & assorted Glands constitute the Integumentary System.
